description: This file defines the Token class used in Twig templating engine to represent lexical tokens during template parsing.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents a lexical token in Twig parsing process, with types, value, and line number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Token instance with type, value, and line number.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Tests if the token matches a specified type and/or value.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Returns the line number of the token.

methods.name: typeToString
methods.description: Converts a token type to its string representation.

methods.name: typeToEnglish
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string of the token type.
